changes.title: Chart sail anywhere
items: For testing: a "🧪 Test: sail anywhere" button on the sea chart (and at the map table) lets you sail to any island with a creature, found or not, without changing your save

changes.title: Biome lakes earlier
items: On the sea chart, the special lakes (ice, lava, oases, sinkholes, tarns, hot springs, rainbow pools and lily ponds) start a phase earlier: about half the lakes in the third ring of islands are special, and all of them further out

changes.title: Legend carries ent
items: On a new island, the treehouse Ent rides on the back of a giant party legend of that island's kind (try ?carrier=bear to see one at home)
